specification.problem: Exact synthesis of an n-qubit (n<=2) unitary with entries in Z[i,1/sqrt2] into a Clifford+T circuit of O(k) gates with at most one ancilla, via decomposition into 1- and 2-level matrices (Giles-Selinger approach).
specification.reconstruction_scope: Only the algebraic ring/entry form, the unitarity constraint, and the generic two-level reduction step for one tiny instance (n=1 or 2, dimension N=2^n) are specified. The paper-specific new method, its O(k) gate-count proof, and the ancilla construction are outside scope.

symbols.domain: N x N unitary over Z[i,1/sqrt2]

symbols.meaning: two-level matrix acting nontrivially on two basis indices

equations.label: Entry form
equations.description: Form of each entry of U.
assumptions: A common k is used for all entries.

equations.label: Unitarity
equations.description: Operator being decomposed must be unitary.
equations.justification: Quantum operators that are exactly synthesizable are unitary; the abstract does not state this explicitly.

equations.label: Two-level decomposition
equations.latex: U=E_1E_2\cdots E_m,\quad E_j \text{ acts nontrivially on two basis states}
equations.description: Factorization into 1- and 2-level matrices (1-level being diagonal phases).
equations.abstract_quote: using decomposition into $1$- and $2$-level matrices which was first proposed by Giles and Selinger
equations.justification: The abstract names this decomposition; the exact form is standard background and not given.

equations.label: Gate bound
equations.description: Claimed gate count scaling for n<=2 with at most one ancilla.
equations.abstract_quote: This method achieves a bound of $O(k)$ gates using at most one ancilla
equations.justification: Stated in the abstract; constants are unspecified.

equations.label: Two-level elimination step
equations.description: Generic step that zeroes one entry of a column using a 2x2 unitary over the ring.
equations.justification: Generic Giles-Selinger-style reduction; the paper's specific reduction is not given.
assumptions: The specific choice of E and its Clifford+T implementation are not known from the abstract.

steps.description: Check that entries have the form in eq_1 with common k and that U is unitary.
Reduce U column by column using two-level elimination steps, leaving a 1-level diagonal.
Implement each 1- and 2-level factor in Clifford+T, with at most one ancilla, for a total gate count O(k).

assumptions: No instance is fixed beyond N=2^n with n<=2.
Giles-Selinger two-level framework is used only as background.
missing_information: The paper's actual reduction and its choice of two-level matrices
Role and construction of the ancilla
Proof and constants of the O(k) bound
